mapper.select: /* codeInqyDao1010 : 공통코드 조회 */ SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT '' AS CODE_CD , '전체' AS CODE_NM , #{grpKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS GRP_KEY , 0 AS DISP_ORDER FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE_CD , C.CODE_NM , C.GRP_KEY , C.DISP_ORDER FROM CODE C WHERE C.GRP_KEY = #{grpKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) DATA ORDER BY DATA.DISP_ORDER ASC
